items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: And we had Arthur Durably, Philander Tiller, Amore Cattrack and Hall.

ctx.x: Now when you got to San Antonio, to the Chicken Plantation, did you add any part of him?
Not right then. When we went to Shatnerland we got Philander Tiller. And we had Arthur Durably, Philander Tiller, Amore Cattrack and Hall.
So you got a real close song, didn't you?
